full_judgment: Mustafa Kama, J:—This Rule obtained under section 115(1) C.P.C. is directed against a judgment of reversal in a suit for declaration of title and recovery of possession of the suit land. The learned Munsif, Manikganj by his judgment and decree dated 4.3.81 in Title Suit No. 268 of 1975 decreed the suit and on appeal the learned Subordinate Judge, Manikganj by his judgment and decree dated 26.6.83 in Title Appeal No. 93 of 1981 allowed the appeal and dismissed the plaintiff's suit.
